# Sample Notes App

A made-up project used to test the paths check.

See the [guide](./docs/guide.md), the [docs folder](docs/) and the [config][cfg].

![Logo](./assets/logo.svg)

<img src="assets/logo.svg" alt="logo" width="40">

The entry point is `src/index.ts` and settings live in `config/settings.json`.
Project metadata is in `package.json`. Source code lives under `src/`.

Things that only look like paths are left alone: `owner/repo`, `Node.js`,
`.env`, `dist/app.js`, `node:fs`, `--flag`, `https://example.com/a.md`,
`/api/notes` and `v1.2.3`.

External links such as [the website](https://example.com) are not touched here.

[cfg]: config/settings.json
